command: printf 'FAK_BENCH_NODE='; hostname; key=$HOME/.config/fak/groq.key; test -s $key; curl -fsS -o /tmp/fak-qwen36-response.json -w 'FAK_BENCH_HTTP=%{http_code} FAK_BENCH_SECONDS=%{time_total}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat $key)" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"qwen/qwen3.6-27b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Reply with benchmark ok"}],"max_tokens":8}' https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions && python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/fak-qwen36-response.json")); assert d.get("model")=="qwen/qwen3.6-27b"; print("FAK_BENCH_MODEL="+d["model"]); print("FAK_BENCH_COMPLETION_TOKENS="+str(d.get("usage",{}).get("completion_tokens",0)))'
